notes.title: Update 1.1.3
notes.notes:
"Hi everyone !

Over time you get used to these controls that seem so horrible and torturous, much faster than you think, and even more so after a few years of working on this project.

Nevertheless it's as best as we can that we are trying with this release to mitigate all this expressed frustration, and despite of our point of view that the platform aspect is becoming much too easy.
But never mind, you are still new to surveying old lost temples.

Well, this release therefore contains a fix for the management of the gamepad, hoping that this improves handling without making the game too easy. In addition to a few other small bugfixes, you might notice a remap of keyboard controls for those who will press the "Default configuration" option in settings, this new configuration seeming to be more intuitive than the old one.

Thank you for playing and do not hesitate to give us some feedback.

Enjoy !"

Sven, Master of Machines.

[img]https://media1.giphy.com/media/VekcnHOwOI5So/giphy.gif?cid=ecf05e4731ds9in0d7hgi774sz3adbk3dam53ybwldepjnvn&rid=giphy.gif[/img]


[b]UPDATE CHANGELOG[/b] :
- Default keyboard mapping change. It should not erase your actual configuration if you already launched the game.
- Minor and major bugs fix. Buggy saves that has been made before 1.1.2 update should not be an issue anymore.
- Gamepad controls improvements.
